source: Wu et al. 2021 (arXiv 2105.14462), Multi30k English-to-French transformer_tiny: width 128, feed-forward 256, four heads, four encoder/decoder layers, dropout 0.3 and shared BPE. Repository adaptation: a fresh training-only joint 10k SentencePiece BPE vocabulary, 20,000 updates, sentence batches of 256, inverse-sqrt from 5e-3 with 2,000 warmup steps, label smoothing 0.1 and best-development-loss selection. These are not an exact replication of the paper's token batching and last-ten-checkpoint averaging. English-to-French has not yet been calibrated; the German score gate and verified recipe status are not reused. All five comparison models use this same recipe.
